args.subject: Group stay enquiry — 10 people in June
args.body:
Hello City Hub Tokyo team,

I'm organising a group stay for 10 people in June. Could you please let me know your availability for a group of this size during June, along with any group-booking rates and requirements?

Our exact dates and room arrangements are not yet specified. Please let me know what further details you need to check availability.

Thank you,
Emma Johnson

final_text: Sent an email to **groups@cityhub-tokyo.jp**, the group-bookings address mentioned in the guest review, asking about availability for **10 people in June**, group rates, and booking requirements.
